dataset.dataset_name: FAPT-Guard Synthetic Temporal ATT&CK Sequence Dataset
dataset.label_definition: target_next_technique_id is the ATT&CK technique on the next chronological event within the same synthetic scenario.
dataset.label_policy: Resolve unique STIX revoked-by chains to active IDs; reject unknown or unresolved inactive IDs. Canonical names come from pinned ATT&CK. Original dataset bytes remain unchanged.
dataset.label_availability_assumption: Synthetic technique annotations are available at event timestamp; not measured sensor detection latency.

normalization.policy: Resolve unique STIX revoked-by chains to active IDs; reject unknown or unresolved inactive IDs. Canonical names come from pinned ATT&CK. Original dataset bytes remain unchanged.

training_dataset: FAPT-Guard Synthetic Temporal ATT&CK Sequence Dataset
random_seed_usage: Random Forest comparison uses seed 42; transition counts are deterministic without randomness

feature_definition.available_features: Last 1/2/3 mapped techniques, technique and transition counts, event/mapped counts, elapsed time, last interval, source counts
feature_definition.excluded: Targets, future events, incident/scenario/template IDs, sample IDs and split

target_definition: Supplied target_next_technique_id normalized through pinned ATT&CK revoked-by relationships; next chronological labelled event after cutoff
selection_rule: Highest validation macro-F1; ties favor transition frequency. Test never used for fitting or selection.

training_configuration.transition_frequency: Suffix lengths 3,2,1 then training prior; unsmoothed frequencies
